missions.title: Drive CodeBot
missions.brief: Run a program, change it, run it again.

flow.title: Drive CodeBot
flow.promise: Meet CodeBot, a robot you code with blocks. In a few steps you will make it drive and light up, right here on screen.

chapters.title: Drive
chapters.code:
from botcore import *
import time

motors.enable(True)

motors.run(LEFT, 50)
motors.run(RIGHT, 50)
time.sleep(1)
motors.run(LEFT, 0)
motors.run(RIGHT, 0)

steps.say: This is **CodeBot**, in the simulator. Drag it to look around.
--Blocks--These blocks are your program: they--/Blocks----Python--This Python is your program: it--/Python-- drive CodeBot forward for one second. Press **▶ Run**.
--Blocks--Click the **50** and make it **100**: full power.--/Blocks----Python--Change **both** 50s to **100**: full power for each wheel.--/Python--
hints: --Blocks--The 50 is in the orange **drive** block. Click it, type 100, then click away.--/Blocks----Python--`motors.run(LEFT, 50)` and `motors.run(RIGHT, 50)`: click just after each 50, delete it, type 100.--/Python--

steps.say: --Blocks--Blocks live in the palette.--/Blocks----Python--The palette has Python too.--/Python-- Open **Lights**.

--Blocks--Drag **turn all top LEDs on** under your drive block.--/Blocks----Python--Click the last line of your program, open **Lights**, and click the **leds.user** card: it goes in under that line.--/Python--

steps.ask: --Blocks--Your blocks are a Python program underneath.--/Blocks-- Which line drives CodeBot?

flow.complete: CodeBot drove at full power and lit up, all from your blocks.
